package postgres

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
)

// ModuleRepoPG implements ModuleRepository.
type ModuleRepoPG struct {
	Pool *pgxpool.Pool
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) Create(ctx context.Context, module domain.Module) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	_, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `INSERT INTO module (id, source_key, tech_id, status, visibility, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at) VALUES ($1,NULLIF($2,''),$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8)`,
		module.ID, module.SourceKey, module.TechID, module.Status, module.Visibility, module.LessonReadAccess, module.CreatedAt, module.UpdatedAt)
	return mapPgError(err)
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Module, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	row := runner.QueryRow(ctx, `SELECT id, tech_id, status, visibility, lesson_read_access, created_at, updated_at FROM module WHERE id=$1`, id)
	var module domain.Module
	if err := row.Scan(&module.ID, &module.TechID, &module.Status, &module.Visibility, &module.LessonReadAccess, &module.CreatedAt, &module.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
		if err == pgx.ErrNoRows {
			return nil, domain.ErrNotFound
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return &module, nil
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) Update(ctx context.Context, module domain.Module) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE module SET tech_id=$1, status=$2, visibility=$3, lesson_read_access=$4, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$5`, module.TechID, module.Status, module.Visibility, module.LessonReadAccess, module.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return mapPgError(err)
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	cmd, err := runner.Exec(ctx, `UPDATE module SET status=$1, updated_at=now() WHERE id=$2`, domain.ModuleStatusNoActive, id)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if cmd.RowsAffected() == 0 {
		return domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return nil
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) List(ctx context.Context, filter filters.ModuleFilters) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	runner := getRunner(ctx, r.Pool)
	args := []any{}
	where := []string{}
	join := ""
	orderBy := "m.created_at ASC, m.id ASC"

	if filter.CourseID != "" {
		args = append(args, filter.CourseID)
		join = "JOIN course_module cm ON cm.module_id = m.id"
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("cm.course_id = $%d", len(args)))
		orderBy = `cm."order" ASC, m.id ASC`
	}
	if filter.CourseID == "" {
		switch filter.Scope {
		case "independent", "standalone":
			args = append(args, domain.ModuleVisibilityStandalone, domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth)
			where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.visibility IN ($%d, $%d)", len(args)-1, len(args)))
		case "content":
			args = append(args, domain.ModuleVisibilityInternal)
			where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.visibility <> $%d", len(args)))
		case "course_only":
			args = append(args, domain.ModuleVisibilityCourseOnly)
			where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.visibility = $%d", len(args)))
		case "both":
			args = append(args, domain.ModuleVisibilityBoth)
			where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.visibility = $%d", len(args)))
		case "internal":
			args = append(args, domain.ModuleVisibilityInternal)
			where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.visibility = $%d", len(args)))
		case "", "all":
		default:
			return nil, domain.ErrValidation
		}
	}
	if filter.TechID != nil {
		args = append(args, *filter.TechID)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.tech_id = $%d", len(args)))
	}
	if filter.ActiveOnly {
		args = append(args, domain.ModuleStatusActive)
		where = append(where, fmt.Sprintf("m.status = $%d", len(args)))
	}

	query := `
SELECT m.id, m.tech_id, m.status, m.visibility, m.lesson_read_access, m.created_at, m.updated_at
FROM module m
` + join
	if len(where) > 0 {
		query += "\nWHERE " + strings.Join(where, " AND ")
	}
	query += "\nORDER BY " + orderBy

	rows, err := runner.Query(ctx, query, args...)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	result := []domain.Module{}
	for rows.Next() {
		var module domain.Module
		if err := rows.Scan(&module.ID, &module.TechID, &module.Status, &module.Visibility, &module.LessonReadAccess, &module.CreatedAt, &module.UpdatedAt); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, module)
	}
	return result, rows.Err()
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) ListAll(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	return r.List(ctx, filters.ModuleFilters{})
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) ListIndependent(ctx context.Context) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	return r.List(ctx, filters.ModuleFilters{Scope: "independent"})
}

func (r ModuleRepoPG) ListByCourse(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	return r.List(ctx, filters.ModuleFilters{CourseID: courseID})
}

var _ repository.ModuleRepository = (*ModuleRepoPG)(nil)
